title: SDW100 2026 Infopack — official archive
claims: The 2026 edition was held over the weekend of 13–14 June 2026, with a 30 hour limit and cut-offs at every aid station.
The 2026 infopack tells runners not to recce the first 5 miles around Matterley Estate and lists course records of Mark Darbyshire (M) 13:42:54 in 2025 and Lucy Gossage (F) 16:30:35 in 2025.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接抓取并读取 2026 届 infopack。该页仍保留 2025 年的赛道纪录，属于赛前版本，不是 2026 届后的更新。
